inspection_method: shallow git clone plus README, CLAUDE.md, Astro content schema, data/catalog files, toolbox installer scripts, package metadata, and deploy/runtime notes

anchors.why: Describes a resource discovery and curation platform with categories, link map, compatibility toolbox, posts, and docs.
Explains commands, CI, build-time scripts vs browser scripts, content collections, toolbox data, routes, layouts, and styling.
Defines categories and posts collections with explicit schemas over Markdown/MDX.
Contains conversion, markdown lint, icon download, SVG optimization, and category config scripts.
Sanitizes tags, resolves icons, builds fallback search links, filters entries, and reports counts.
Stores package/link catalog data consumed by interactive directory and toolbox pages.

known_limits: This is a resource directory, not an evidence-reviewed knowledge base.
Toolbox command generation and package lists must not be used as VAKS action basis.
Loose schemas and generated category Markdown require explicit provenance if adapted.
